task_text: Find the measuring cup, then the dish brush and put each in the bin, in that order. Each target counts when its centre is inside the bin (within 0.056 m x 0.052 m of the bin's centre along the bin's horizontal axes and at most 0.26 m above its floor) while it is the current target: first the measuring cup, then the dish brush. Success: every target has counted (a counted target may leave the bin again). Distractors in the bin do not matter. The goal must hold for 30 consecutive control steps (1.02 s); the episode then ends in success.
